drivingQuestion: Whose view in the baraita on the rider is the halakha?
outcomeNote: The halakha is decided in accordance with Rabbi.

segments.he: אָמַר רָבָא, וְאִיתֵּימָא רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֶּן לֵוִי: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי.
segments.en: «Rava, and some say Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, said:» The «halakha» here «is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi.

moves.summary: Rava (or, some say, R' Yehoshua ben Levi) rules that the halakha follows Rabbi in the baraita of the preceding unit.
moves.about: the halakha follows Rabbi: a rider prays seated in place whether or not someone can hold his donkey

edges.about: the halakha follows Rabbi: a rider prays seated in place whether or not someone can hold his donkey
the ruling that the halakha follows Rabbi is alternatively attributed to R' Yehoshua ben Levi rather than Rava
